string.name: text
string.value: With your latest lead, you finally felt like you were putting together the pieces to the puzzle.

string.name: text
string.value: Sugar, Tess, Rondo, and Olive met you at the El Nath Crystal Passageway to pursue the Master of Disguise.

string.name: text
string.value: While there, Rondo overheard some Black Wings saying that their leaders were collecting Seal Stones, though they weren't sure why.

string.name: text
string.value: With Sugar's help, you managed to defeat the Master of Disguise! You returned the Seal Stone to Athena Pierce, in person this time.

string.name: text
string.value: Everything worked out in the end, but the questions lingered.

string.name: text
string.value: What were the Seal Stones? What was the Black Wings' ultimate goal?

string.name: text
string.value: And most importantly of all, was the Black Mage directly involved in all of this?
